claim: Baltussen, Da and Soebhag (2025): in US stocks 1993-2019 the return from the previous close to 15:00 predicts a reversal in 15:30-16:00; long-short 3.78 bp a day value-weighted and 6.86 bp equal-weighted gross, 14.71 bp for the smallest 20 percent and 3.41 bp for the largest 20 percent; the authors say the strategy might not be exploitable by many investors after transaction costs.
quote: might not be exploitable by many investors after accounting for transaction costs
limitations: Gross numbers, value-weighted by lagged market cap, no ETFs, working paper; no independent replication found.
impact_on_spec: Group G2 signal, window and the paper-faithful variant (pc_to_1500); source of the cost caveat.

claim: Baltussen, Da, Lammers and Martens (JFE 2021): in 60+ futures 1974-2020 the last 30 minutes' return is positively predicted by the rest-of-day return; linked to gamma hedging of options market makers and leveraged ETFs; out-of-sample R2 up to about 2.9 percent for equity index futures.
quote: Out-of-sample R2 for equity index futures up to about 2.9%
limitations: Futures not single stocks; effect reverts over following days.
independent_replication: Gao et al. 2018 for SPY; local T-15 B group did not reproduce the size out of sample.
impact_on_spec: Mechanism behind group G1: hedging demand from options and leveraged ETFs, strongest where both are active.

claim: Concretum Research: SPY overnight-gap-reversal signal combined with noise-area intraday momentum, 2018-01-01 to 2024-06-05, Sharpe 1.95, 31.3 percent a year, max drawdown 10.0 percent, commission only; the gap leg alone is not reported.
quote: an overnight gap reversal signaling strategy
limitations: Combination only, no spread or slippage, 2 percent overnight threshold is rare; no third-party replication found.
impact_on_spec: Group G3: ETF gap leg alone and combined with the QQQ noise band.

claim: Direxion launched AMZU, GGLL and MSFU (1.5X single-stock bull ETFs) on 2022-09-07, after TSLL and AAPU; so TSLA, AAPL, AMZN, GOOGL and MSFT had single-stock leveraged ETFs well before the 2024-01-08 window start (NVDA from 2023-09 per search summaries).
quote: Amazon, Google and Microsoft are three of the world's largest stocks, are heavily traded, and are widely recognized.
limitations: NVDU/T-REX dates come from search summaries; issuer product pages returned 403; AUM not obtained.
impact_on_spec: Point-in-time definition of the G1 pool LETF6.

claim: Zarattini, Aziz and Barbon (SFI WP 24-97, 2024): SPY noise-area intraday momentum, band = max/min(open, previous close) x (1 +/- VM x sigma), sigma the mean absolute move from the open over 14 days at the same minute, positions set at semi-hourly checks, stopped by band and VWAP, flat at the close; Sharpe 1.33 with volatility targeting 2007-2024.
quote: trading is restricted to semi-hourly intervals
limitations: Author-reported, no out-of-sample split, SPY only.
independent_replication: T-20261006-15 reproduced the relative conclusions on SPY 2016-2024-04 (0.76/1.11 vs 1.24/1.33) and found the recent edge in QQQ only.
impact_on_spec: Rule for G1 (and the QQQ leg of the G3 combination).

claim: Gao, Han, Li and Zhou (JFE 2018): the first half-hour return on the market predicts the last half-hour return (SPY 1993-2013); local T-15 found the published size absent after 2016.
quote: the first half-hour return on the market predicts the
limitations: Index level, 1993-2013; local T-20261006-15 group B did not reproduce the size out of sample.
impact_on_spec: Background for the last-hour structure that G2 and the hedging-demand mechanism of G1 share; local replication already negative.

claim: Heston, Korajczyk and Sadka (JF 2010): return continuation at half-hour intervals that are multiples of a trading day; the authors say exploiting it loses money after the bid-ask spread.
quote: lose money, after paying the bid-ask spread
independent_replication: Local T-13 on a different pool negative after costs.
impact_on_spec: Why G2 uses a 30-minute gap between signal and trade in the paper-faithful variant and why spreads decide the result.

claim: Alpaca paper trading matches orders against the NBBO, quantity is not checked against NBBO size, partial fills of random size happen 10 percent of the time.
